DA  
 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/FIRST APPEAL NO. 2724 of 2022  ==========================================================
 GUJARAT STATE ROAD TRANSPORT CORPORATION  Versus  AGARBEN HIRABHAI DESAI (DECEASED) & ORS.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 MR HS MUNSHAW(495) for the Appellant(s) No. 1  DECEASED LITIGANT THROUGH LEGAL HEIRS/ REPRESTENTATIVES  for the Defendant(s) No. 1  MR HARDIK P MEHTA(6943) for the Defendant(s) No. 3  MR MAKBUL I MANSURI(2694) for the Defendant(s) No. 1.1,1.2,1.3,1.4  MR VISHAL C MEHTA(6152) for the Defendant(s) No. 2  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HASMUKH D. SUTHAR  Date : 05/02/2026  ORAL ORDER (1) Insurance Company is in First Appeal under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Challenge is made to the judgment and award dated 20.02.2018 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Deesa, Banaskantha, in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.208 of 2010.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Deesa, Banaskantha
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Motor Accident Claim Petition No.208 of 2010
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: (2) Perusal of the judgment and award indicates that Insurance Company has challenged the judgment and award made to the tune of Rs.02,30,000/- to the victim of the road accident.

(3)
Heard learned advocates for the respective parties.

(4) Since the amount involved in the First Appeal is meager , paying due regard to smallness of amount, this Court is of the considered view that the First Appeal should be disposed of as compensation awarded seems to be just and reasonable and no interference is called.
It is hereby made clear that this First Appeal is disposed of only on the ground of award of compensation being meager and small.

sentences.text: It is made clear that this order will not come in the way of adjudication of any other First Appeal pending against same judgment and award or adjudication of any other claim petition arising from same road accident.

Since the First Appeal is disposed of only on the contention of monetary value being small, principle of res judicata shall not be applied to any other proceedings arising from the same road accident or same judgment and award.
(5) In view of above, the First Appeal is dismissed.
Pending Civil Application, if any, stands disposed of as having become infructuous.
(6) Record and Proceedings and amount, if any lying before this Court is ordered to be transmitted to the concerned Tribunal forthwith along with accrued interest, if any.

opennyai_summary.decision:
It is hereby made clear that this First Appeal is disposed of only on the ground of award of compensation being meager and small.
It is made clear that this order will not come in the way of adjudication of any other First Appeal pending against same judgment and award or adjudication of any other claim petition arising from same road accident.
Since the First Appeal is disposed of only on the contention of monetary value being small, principle of res judicata shall not be applied to any other proceedings arising from the same road accident or same judgment and award.
(5) In view of above, the First Appeal is dismissed.
Pending Civil Application, if any, stands disposed of as having become infructuous.
No order as to costs.
(6) Record and Proceedings and amount, if any lying before this Court is ordered to be transmitted to the concerned Tribunal forthwith along with accrued interest, if any.
The entire awarded amount be disbursed and released in favour of the claimants after due verification by transferring the said amount to the account of the claimants either by RTGS or NEFT mode.
